figures.title: Normalized return across seeds
figures.caption: Mean return with ±1 std across 5 seeds; the min-max objective overtakes CLEAR at 0.92M environment steps.
figures.details:
**Synthetic pipeline check.** Learning curves for three continual-RL objectives on a stand-in MinAtar task suite.

- **Method.** Alternating local/global primal-dual policy gradient (min-max), compared against CLEAR replay and naive fine-tuning.
- **Seeds.** 5 per method, shown as mean ± 1 std. Faint per-seed traces appear in the small-multiples variant.
- **What to look for.** The crossover point, and whether the min-max band separates from the CLEAR band rather than merely shifting.

Data is generated by `report/make_sample_figures.py` and carries no experimental meaning.

figures.title: Parameter trajectory under consolidation
figures.caption: Iterates drift out of the shallow local basin into the global one over 24 consolidation steps.
figures.details:
**Synthetic pipeline check.** A mixture-of-Gaussians loss surface with the parameter iterate drawn over it.

- **Why animate.** The *order* in which the iterate leaves the shallow basin is the point; a single static path hides the pacing and the early dwell time.
- **Static form.** Four selected frames as a small multiple, never the blank first frame.
- **What to look for.** How long the iterate lingers near the local basin before the drift term dominates.

Surface and path are generated by `report/make_sample_figures.py`.

figures.title: Forgetting matrix across the task sequence
figures.caption: Return delta on each earlier task after training every later task; blue is forgetting, red is backward transfer.
figures.details:
**Synthetic pipeline check.** Entry (i, j) is the change in return on task j measured after training on task i.

- **Scale.** Diverging blue → light → red, centred at zero, so the sign of transfer is readable without a legend lookup. No rainbow.
- **What to look for.** Whether forgetting deepens monotonically with task distance or saturates, and any positive (red) entries indicating backward transfer.

Generated by `report/make_sample_figures.py`.

figures.title: Final retention by task
figures.caption: Retained return per task at the end of the sequence, mean ±1 std over 5 seeds, with the per-seed spread alongside.
figures.details:
**Synthetic pipeline check.** Retention is the fraction of a task's peak return still held once the whole sequence has been trained.

- **Variants.** Bars carry the trend and the uncertainty; the box variant shows the distribution the bars summarise. Two views of the same numbers, not two renderings of one view.
- **What to look for.** Whether retention decays smoothly with task position or drops at a particular boundary, and whether the spread widens for later tasks.

Generated by `report/make_sample_figures.py`.
